title: Marital compatibility and its relationship to marital variables: a sociological study on married Libyan women in Tripoli
core_idea: Identify the dimensions of marital adjustment among married Libyan wives in Tripoli and examine whether marital adjustment is influenced by type of family, type of marriage, age difference between spouses, duration of marriage, and criteria for spouse selection using a social survey of 315 wives in the Andalus neighborhood.
tldr: A sociological survey designed to map dimensions of marital adjustment among married women in Tripoli and test associations with selected marital and family variables (family type, marriage type, spousal age gap, marriage duration, and spouse-selection criteria).
